capabilities: publish notes as PDF, EPUB 3 or DOCX files
assemble books from chapter notes with a reading-order plan
apply reusable note templates and form-based design presets
measure generated pages to produce paperback proofs with calculated gutters
save output to a configurable vault folder with preserved existing files
extras: Rendering runs entirely on-device with no telemetry; the README notes a file-size limitation under the Obsidian Sync Standard and points to external guides (installation, supported content and limits, rendering architecture) for details. Stable releases are on GitHub Releases with BRAT as the beta channel; physical mobile rendering and assistive-technology acceptance checks are still ongoing.
problem: Obsidian can only export notes in limited ways and has no built-in way to produce EPUB/DOCX documents or assemble a book from chapter notes.

relations.evidence: BRAT remains available for beta builds

summary: Publishing plugin that turns Markdown notes into typeset PDFs, EPUB 3 ebooks and editable Word documents with reusable layouts and presets.
